scope: Read-only toolchain audit plus explicitly requested scratch Redis source download/build; no repository or remote mutations.

python.asrCapability: No ASR module or model found in checked environments; shared historic pipeline existing is not current capability.

site.reason: Avoid concurrent site writes and expensive build during author preparation.

redisStyle.header: RedisHeader requires real ep and accepts short title/chapter; fixed x570 title and x768 chapter can collide with long titles, inspect actual text bounds.
redisStyle.referenceMapping: success->red; redis palette has no success field
redisStyle.coverBasis: episodes/_shared/redis-covers-v2/; do not mutate old frozen catalogs/styles or use old installer for new slugs without local adapter.

pitfalls: Do not copy Kafka identity/palette/archival declarations into new Redis wrappers.
Old shared redis-video/references.py is for historical skiplist restyling and declares preserving original narration/timing; new episodes need local truthful adapter.
MQ15 normalize-color.py performs real full-range BT601 to limited BT709 pixel conversion, then checks stream and decoded frame tags. Merely setting flags gives wrong silver/red colors.
New bibliography must match limited BT709 body and same real color conversion. Preserve immutable shared appenders and freeze actual adapter dependencies.
Reference list is title-author, four entries/page, five seconds/page; source research/title evidence and article quotes need real paths.
Source tarball redis-server --version reports sha00000000; provenance is official tag+commit GET evidence and archive SHA, not that field.
Build uses libc/noTLS/O2; any LRU memory experiment must report actual allocator/config/INFO, not performance guarantees.
Final reference appendix frames differ from body voice/storyboard frames; verification must keep both identities.
No new TTS, ASR, site build, video render, freeze, or episode/shared mutations performed by this audit.
